qualification_scope: Common reference-Richards provider-context isolation for the admitted swkimpl=0, macropore-off, free-drainage fixture profile with explicit constitutive, source/sink and top-boundary providers. This qualifies the isolation seam and heterogeneous provider concurrency using immutable qualification providers; it does not qualify a production corrected-B1.10 constitutive provider or the general production parallel reference backend.

test_evidence.meaning: Admitted common adapter route contains no direct qdra/qssdi/qrot/watcon/hconduc/moiscap/dhconduc/cofgen provider token reads and HeadCalc has explicit constitutive/source-sink provider seams.
When explicit providers reproduce the F-SI07 fixture values, current F-SI08 outputs are identical to the exact F-SI07 tested source at O0/O2 and 1/2/4/8 workers.
Distinct immutable provider instances and parameters remain isolated across serial and concurrent common-route solves while incompatible legacy qdra/qssdi/qrot globals are deliberately poisoned.
Missing constitutive or source/sink provider fails before HeadCalc entry; diagnostic labels fit the existing 32-character common diagnostics field.
Existing transaction and worker ownership regression remains executable and green.

mass_accounting.reason_full_balance_not_qualified: F-SI08 exercises the isolated reference solver/provider fixture rather than the complete SWAP water-accounting chain.

hold_reasons.production_b1_10_constitutive_provider: The corrected B1.10 oracle manifest pins MOD_MvG_functions.f90, but the current production source tree does not yet contain an exact source-bound concrete B1.10 provider object. F-SI08 does not recreate historical formulas.
hold_reasons.production_b1_10_source_sink_provider: F-SI08 qualifies the source/sink interface and ownership seam using deterministic providers. Full production process composition for drainage, irrigation and root extraction remains to be source-bound without moving physics ownership into the solver.
hold_reasons.parallel_reference_backend: Provider-object isolation is proven, but the actual corrected B1.10 constitutive and process providers are not yet production-materialized and qualified.
hold_reasons.swkimpl1: Requires dynamic RootExtraction and dK/dh provider behavior through the explicit context without changing numerical policy.
hold_reasons.macropore: Requires composition with the separately owned F-KT optional continuation state contract and explicit macropore provider qualification.
